description: Executable coding and tech-stack checks injected into implementation prompts and verified by implementation_readiness_check.py.

checks.check: gofmt -l on changed Go files is empty
go vet ./... passes for each changed module
context propagated; DB pools/connections reused; no per-call pool creation
errors wrapped/classified; no string matching for control flow except documented DB constraint names
transaction boundaries explicit; uniqueness enforced by constraint/index; rollback tested
FORCE RLS; runtime role NOSUPERUSER/NOBYPASSRLS; cross-tenant read/write rejected
up/down migration applied on disposable DB; backup marker recorded before destructive change
tenant-scoped keys; sha256/ref validation; atomic write; bounded GC with grace; no orphan on failure
authn/authz at boundary; tenant scope server-resolved; no caller-controlled tenant/path/DSN/limits
input validation and fail-closed config; negative and API contract tests
invalid enum/missing required config fails closed and is tested
each failure mode has an owner signal/threshold or explicit N/A reason
no dead/unused/unwired controls; self-review removes unused imports, vars and duplicate logic
